svg.title: TripSync: Collaborative travel planner. I built the server and API, Gemini itinerary suggestions and a real-time chat room for every plan.
svg.desc: Stack: Express, PostgreSQL, Sequelize, Socket.IO, Gemini, React. Server + API by me. Chat room per plan.
